data.name: Thanu
data.gender_notes: Thanu is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Tamil word 'Thalai' meaning joy and 'Anu' meaning new, Thanu is a beautiful and rare name that represents the joy of new beginnings and the happiness that comes with them. The name Thanu carries the meaning “Joy” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Tamil, Telugu, Kannada. Parents who choose Thanu usually hope their child will grow to embody joy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Thanu is a sacred name in Hinduism that is believed to bring joy and happiness to the bearer. It is also associated with the goddess Parvati, who is the embodiment of love, beauty, and nature.
data.etymology: Thanu belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Joy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Thanu total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

Thanu is a name that is often given to newborn babies to signify the joy and excitement of their arrival in the world. Additionally, it is a popular name among newlyweds as it represents the beginning of a new life together. Thanu is also a name that holds significance in Hindu mythology, as it is believed to be the name of various gods and goddesses associated with joy, happiness, and new beginnings.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Thanu signifies the innate joy and happiness that exists within each of us.
